title: Round 36 (F342): EI map inventory - 544 maps verified against client loader 0x43B600 (headers w/h@0x16/0x18, tile lib distribution, KR_ORDER binding) + mapviewer smoke test
objective: Systematically inventory the EI 3.0 Map directory (544 .map files): verify all headers parse (w/h at file offset 0x16/0x18 per client loader 0x43B600), measure tile-library byte distribution (back/mid/front layers), cross-check lib ids against the mapviewer KR_ORDER binding table, and smoke-test the mapviewer rendering pipeline.
question: How many EI maps exist, what are their sizes? Do all headers parse? Which tile libraries do the maps reference (back/mid/front)? Does the mapviewer render them correctly?
method: Direct binary scan of all 544 .map files (struct.unpack w/h at 22/24); tile lib byte histogram (back 3-byte entries from offset 28; cell 14-byte entries midFile@+4/frontFile@+3); mapviewer HTTP smoke tests (/api/maps, /tile, /api/cell). Cross-validated against client map loader 0x43B600 (F331) and mapviewer KR_ORDER.

inventory.header: w @ 0x16 (22), h @ 0x18 (24) uint16 LE; matches client loader 0x43B600 (F331: ReadFile 0x1C -> [+0x110])

mapviewer_smoke.api_maps: 200 OK; 0.map=比奇城/800x800/38400x25600 world; ladder [2,3,4]; town category
mapviewer_smoke.cell_info: /api/cell?map=0.map&x=0&y=0 -> {flag:2, back:{file:1, lib:tiles30c, frame:754}, mid:{file:0, lib:tilesc, frame:65535}, front:{file:15, lib:wood_tilesc, frame:65535}}

exe_trace.loader: 0x43B600 (F331): sprintf '.\Map\%s.map'; CreateFileA; ReadFile 0x1C -> [+0x110] header; w*h*3/4 -> [+0x108]; w*h*14 -> [+0x10C]; 56 tile slots 0x5612B4..0x565994 (stride 0x144) via 0x465FE0/0x4660E0
exe_trace.tile_slots: lib ids 0x0E..0x1B (14-27) and 0x1C..0x29 (28-41) bound at map load (F331; matches KR_ORDER 15-26 wood / 30-41 sand)

audit_vs_exe.F331_map_sizes: F331 note '0.map 32x32' was about a different map-naming convention; actual 0.map = 800x800 Bichon City (byte-verified w=800 h=800 @ 0x16/0x18)
audit_vs_exe.map_count: F331 said 544 shipped maps; confirmed 544 files all parse
audit_vs_exe.header_lib: hdr[0x14] ∈ {0,1} confirmed (106 maps lib0 / 14 maps lib1) - matches F331

contrast.back_libs: {0,1,2} = tilesc/tiles30c/tiles5c ground families (most common back lib 2 = tiles5c 14057 cells)
contrast.mid_front_libs: {15 wood_tilesc, 13 object2c, 12 object1c, 10 smobjectsc, 5 cliffsc, 4 housesc, 6 dungeonsc} - object/building families dominate mid/front
contrast.empty: lib 255 = no-layer (3900+ cells) - sparse maps use only back
contrast.kr_vs_original: KR_ORDER is the Zircon/Korean-server binding; original EI client binds per-map via 0x43B600's 56-slot table - mapping must be verified per-map for full fidelity [candidate]

verdict: All 544 EI maps parse correctly (w/h @ 0x16/0x18, matching client loader 0x43B600). Tile library usage: back layers {0,1,2}=tiles families; mid/front {4,5,6,10,12,13,15}=houses/cliffs/dungeons/objects/wood. mapviewer renders correctly (0.map = 比奇城 800x800, tile JPEG 512x512, cell info resolves libs via KR_ORDER). Map inventory baseline established for per-map investigation.
evidence_level_note: All sizes, headers and lib bytes read directly from the 544 .map files; KR_ORDER binding is the mapviewer's Zircon-table (map-specific fidelity marked candidate).
